items.name: Chunk streaming
items.note: Regenerated data shows no streaming cost beyond noise (docs/world-data.md). 500 m scheduler, now nearest-first, drops stale jobs and late arrivals, generation-guarded builds. Collision indexes per chunk and batches rebuild once per chunk. Measured on an M1 route: time in >50 ms frames about halved. Since P1 (2026-10-30) the pedestrian graph joins chunks incrementally and chunk work runs in a 6 ms per-frame queue: teleport worst frame 517 -> 52 ms on the M1. Mesh build still runs on the main thread.

items.name: Road graph topology
items.note: public/world regenerated on 2026-10-30 from the same 2026-10-28 extract (generator 9037ea4): 174 components (was 5,565), largest 98.6 % of nodes (was 71.8 %), 30 dead ends within 5 cm of another road (was 6,710), 0 duplicate edge ids. Every non-road layer is identical. The remaining parts are mostly footpaths OSM does not join. Since T1 traffic drives edges of any length (sim net 97.38 % of its nodes in the largest part, was 90.8 %); it still removes cars at dead ends. See docs/world-data.md and docs/traffic.md.

items.name: Golden views and A/B timing (P0)
items.note: scripts/look: 27 fixed views (3 districts x street/medium/aerial x day/night/rain), pixel compare, alternated A/B against docs/budgets.json. Two runs of one build: 27 of 27 the same. M1 Air only.

items.name: Streaming without long frames, far ring (P1)
items.note: M1 Air, 3 alternated rounds x2: teleport worst frame 517 -> 52 ms and 389 -> 44 ms, p99 under 50 ms, ring loaded in 0.8 s. Far ring to 3.25 km on High; day fog still hides most of it beyond 2.5 km. No workers. Not measured on a reference PC.

items.name: World data schema v2 (P2)
items.note: public/world is v2 since 6ee2f27 (dev/engine-core, not pushed). Generator, validation, compat layer and runtime rules are on dev/engine-core. The v2 run passes the schema diff (all 1,298 v1 chunks byte-equal through toV1) and the raw OSM check (70,277 attributed features match, points within 7 mm). Golden views are identical, and the in-game A/B shows no cost. After the swap: 136 of 136 tests, golden views 27 of 27 the same against pre-swap v1, A/B passes every budget (docs/p2-record.md). Nothing renders v2 fields yet.
